reviews.text: It’s a really fun game and I play it a lot! But there were a couple of times where it would show me a picture and say that it was a different thing. Like one time I was doing the Disney character one because I’m a Disney fan and the picture showed cruella de vil and so I was trying to put cruella and there wasn’t an e so I was pretty confused, then I had to watch a lot of adds to get enough clues to figure out what it was. The game said that the picture was URSALLA! Then I was a little confused but it’s still a great game and I would recommend trying it to many people!
